text.tspan: VENUS combine your SPARQL query with an encoding specification to generate an interactive visualization.
to retrieve from the knowledge graph.
Each actor is a source node
All source nodes have the same color
Each movie is a target node
This query retrieves movies, their actors and
their distributors along with human-readable labels.
Each variable in the SELECT clause is refered as a field
in the encoding and can be used to define:
- marks such as nodes and links and
- channels such as color and size.
VENUS builds the graph from the encoding and the query results:
- size represent number of links (actors in a movies and vice-versa)
